name: CR-Diff-02-linearity-3.a
questiontext:
Expand the powers and find the following derivative:
 \[ \frac{d}{d{{CT:0}}}\left[\sqrt{{CT:1}}\right] . \]

 [[input:ans1]] [[validation:ans1]]
generalfeedback:
In order to solve this problem we will have to use the linearity rules for differentition <hint>calc_diff_linearity_rule</hint> and the properties of exponentials <hint>alg_indices</hint>.

 \[\begin{array}{rcl}\displaystyle
   \frac{d}{d{{CT:0}}}\left[\sqrt{\left({{CT:1}}\right)}\right] &\displaystyle =&\displaystyle  \frac{d}{d{{CT:0}}}\left( {{CT:2}}\right) \\
    &\displaystyle =&\displaystyle  {{CT:3}}\cdot \frac{d}{d{{CT:0}}}({{CT:4}}) \\
    &\displaystyle =&\displaystyle  {{CT:3}}\cdot {{CT:5}} \\
    &\displaystyle =&\displaystyle  {{CT:6}}
  \end{array}\]

on_true.feedback:
